description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for charge requests within the Fineract platform. It includes properties such as charge applicability, name, currency, timing, calculation type, amount, status flags, payment mode, fee schedule, payment type, caps, and tax group ID. It is used for transferring charge-related data across different parts of the system, particularly in API requests.

classes.name: ChargeRequest
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a request to create or update a charge, containing various charge configuration parameters.

methods.description: Default constructor, initializes a new instance of the ChargeRequest class with default values.
